billing.rounding: Each job rounds up to the next whole minute.
billing.notes: Rates are for private repositories after included minutes. Standard runners are free on public repositories; larger runners are not. Rates in effect since January 1, 2026.

billing.rounding: Per minute, rounded to the nearest minute.
billing.freeTier: 3,000 x64 2-vCPU minutes per month per organization.
billing.notes: Larger Linux and Windows runners scale linearly with vCPU from the 2-vCPU rate.

Plans: Developer $20/month with 2,000 minutes, Startup $200/month with 20,000 minutes. Included minutes are 2-vCPU Linux minutes; larger runners use a minutes multiplier. Prices here are the per-minute rates in the runner-types docs.

billing.rounding: Minimum 1 minute; the next 15 seconds round down.
billing.notes: Billed in unit minutes: max(vCPU, GB RAM / 2) x minutes x platform multiplier (Linux 1, Windows 2, macOS 10); macOS shapes use the published per-shape rates. usdPerMinute is the overage rate ($0.0015 per unit minute); usdPerMinutePrepaid is the effective in-plan rate ($0.001). Team $100/month includes 100,000 unit minutes; Business $250/month includes 250,000.
Service stopped running jobs and billing on March 31, 2026. Listed rates are historical and must not be used for current jobs.

billing.freeTier: $2.50 credit per month (1,250 minutes of 2-vCPU runner time).
billing.notes: New accounts get premium runners by default; they can be turned off in account settings.

Runs in your own AWS account: you pay AWS for compute plus an annual license (Starter $350/yr under 50k jobs/month, Growth $1,050, Scale $2,100, Sponsorship $4,200; free for non-commercial use). Per-minute prices are RunsOn's published us-east-1 spot examples (7-day average, cheapest zone, including 30 GB gp3) and vary with AWS prices.
Cloud runners billed per minute. Bring-your-own-cloud runners cost $0.002/min plus your cloud bill.

runners.notes: Bring your own cloud: WarpBuild fee only, plus your cloud compute bill.
